Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly defined the relationship between height and gravitational potential energy. It stated that "gravitational potential energy increases as height decreases," which is physically impossible. Potential energy ($PE = mgh$) decreases as an object moves down a hill (height decreases). Because of this fundamental physics error in the first step, the Planner arrived at the wrong conclusion (Option 4) instead of the correct one (Option 2).
